titulo_es: Order of words in extensive subordinates

Varför beslutet inte kunde vänta.es: Explicó por qué la decisión no podía esperar
Varför beslutet inte kunde vänta.en: He explained why the decision could not wait

texto: Control order, denial and adverbs in extensive subordinates. **Varför beslutet inte kunde vänta** means «He explained why the decision could not wait». Analyzes the scope and registration of the expression. Distinguish the data of the interpretation, check what evidence it holds and practice a precise paraphrase. Sequence 1 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
